subject: spanish
title: Polite Phrases
final_note: Politeness opens doors in Spanish too.

walkthroughs.body_html: Por favor = please. Literally 'for a favour'. Use whenever you ask for something — 'un cafe, por favor' (a coffee, please).
Gracias = thanks. Muchas gracias = many thanks. Reply: De nada (literally 'of nothing' = you're welcome).
Perdon = sorry/excuse me (small things, like bumping someone). Lo siento = I'm sorry (bigger apologies).

mcqs.q: Where do most descriptive adjectives go relative to the noun?
options: Before the noun, as in English.
